story_review.one_viewing_summary: A driverless car picks riders up at the San Antonio airport. The service started in February in a 60 square mile area. In April one empty car was carried down a creek and another stalled in a flooded street. A software recall covering nearly 3,800 cars says the software may let a car slow and then drive into standing water. The record lists the remedy as under development, with interim weather limits and an update reaching every car by April 20. The ride is open while the remedy is still pending.
story_review.opening_to_ending: The film opens on a hailed ride arriving at the airport curb. The middle moves through two disclosed flood examples to the recall's own sentence, performed as a car rolling into water. It returns to the same curb with the open-door ride beside the record card still marked under development.
